title: Hanna crosses the desert with her camera (paraphrase)
topic: A photographer named Hanna travels through a desert: dunes in the evening light, a night in tents near a well, a caravan at dawn, packing for the journey home
tail_E: The guide lifts Hanna onto the back of a kneeling
target_note: Same target as formulation A: 'camel' is predictable only from the desert context (desert, dunes, sand, well, caravan); the animal that kneels to be mounted in the desert is the camel ('the guide' is the local man of unit 3). The word does not occur in the units or the tail, and neither does its German equivalent 'Kamel'. ' camel' is a single Pythia token (id 46493). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' camel') = 0.22 on the all-English rendering, rank 1 (next: ' horse' 0.13).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (DEV03B, photographer Hanna, paraphrase, development family)
notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten DEV03A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Hanna). Replacements include travels through the desert with her camera/journeys across the desert with her camera equipment (reist durch die Wüste/durchquert die Wüste), sun burns on the hot sand/sun blazes above the hot sand (brennt/glüht), local guide leads her to a high dune/local man guides her up a tall dune (einheimischer Führer bringt sie/Einheimischer führt sie), photographs the dunes in the evening light/takes pictures of the dunes at sunset (fotografiert/macht Aufnahmen), wind carries fine sand across the track/gusts of wind blow fine sand over the trail (Wind trägt/Windstöße wehen - singular/plural subject), travellers sleep in tents near a well/group camps in tents beside a well (Reisende schlafen/Gruppe übernachtet - plural/singular subject), stars shine over the silent desert/stars glitter above the quiet desert (leuchten/funkeln), changes the lens before sunrise/swaps the lens before daybreak (wechselt/tauscht), long caravan reaches the well at dawn/caravan arrives at the well at first light (erreicht/gelangt zum), packs her bags for the journey home/stows her things for the trip back (packt ihre Taschen/verstaut ihre Sachen). 'durchquert' (unit 1) and 'übernachtet' (unit 6) are inseparable; no separable verbs. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Development family: used for dose/threshold choice only.
